name: Polymarket
shortDescription: Decentralized prediction market on Polygon for real-world events.
description: A decentralized prediction market platform that enables individuals to speculate on the outcomes of future real-world events. Built on the Polygon blockchain, it offers transparent, peer-to-peer trading across politics, sports, and economics.
pricingDetails: Free to use. Taker fees only, set by market category (0.04-0.07 on the p*(1-p) curve); makers pay nothing. No resolution fee. Verified 2026-10-21 against Polymarket's fee documentation.
eligibility: Two products with separate eligibility. polymarket.com is the international, crypto venue: signup is an email address or a self-custody wallet, and trading is closed to US IPs, which the geoblock documentation classes as close-only on both frontend and API, alongside a long restricted list that includes the UK, Germany, France, Australia, Brazil, Singapore, Thailand and four Canadian provinces, with OFAC-sanctioned countries blocked outright. polymarket.us is the US venue, operated by QCX LLC as a CFTC-designated contract market: US residents open an account in the app and must pass KYC (legal name, residential address, date of birth, phone, Social Security number, plus a government ID and selfie check if the automated check asks for more) before they can deposit or trade. Eligibility is not the same as legality: the geoblock endpoint is the operational test for the international venue, and state courts are still contesting the US product. Sources: Polymarket Documentation, 'Geographic Restrictions'; Polymarket US Documentation, 'Create an Account' and 'What is Polymarket US?'; checked 2026-10-21.
apiAccess: Documented for both venues. The international stack at docs.polymarket.com is split into a Gamma API (gamma-api.polymarket.com) for events and market metadata, a CLOB API (clob.polymarket.com) for order-book reads and order placement, a Data API v2 for positions, activity and leaderboards, WebSocket streams for market and account events, and a geoblock endpoint that reports whether the caller's IP may trade. Public reads need no key; trading is signed by the account's signer key. Polymarket US has its own documented API at docs.polymarket.us: a keyless public gateway (gateway.polymarket.us) for markets, events and search, and an authenticated api.polymarket.us for orders, portfolio and balances with two WebSocket streams, keys issued through the app after identity verification. Sources: docs.polymarket.com, 'Overview' and 'Geographic Restrictions'; docs.polymarket.us, 'Introduction' and 'Authentication'; checked 2026-10-21.
goodFor: Crypto-native trading on Polygon: non-custodial, USDC collateral, settlement visible on-chain
Building on documented APIs: Gamma, CLOB and Data for the international venue, a public plus authenticated API for the US one
Trading from most countries outside the geoblock list without a brokerage account or USD bank rails
US residents who specifically want a CFTC-regulated, USD venue, which is what polymarket.us is
notGoodFor: US traders who want polymarket.com: the international venue is close-only for US IPs and its API rejects orders from blocked regions
Privacy from KYC at the US venue: Polymarket US wants SSN, date of birth and a government ID before you can deposit
Anyone in a close-only jurisdiction such as the UK, Germany, France, Australia or much of Canada who wants to open new positions

name: Kalshi
shortDescription: First federally regulated event contract exchange in the US.
description: The first federally regulated exchange in the United States dedicated specifically to trading on the outcome of real-world events. Regulated by the CFTC, Kalshi allows users to purchase 'event contracts' on everything from economic indicators to entertainment results.
pricingDetails: Free to sign up. Trading fee = round up(0.07 x contracts x price x (1-price)), which is $0.07-$1.75 per 100 contracts. No settlement fee on simple yes/no. Some series charge maker fees. Verified 2026-10-21 against Kalshi's fee schedule.
eligibility: Individuals aged 18 or older who pass identity and document verification at signup, which Kalshi says it runs to meet CFTC identity rules. Kalshi now takes members from many countries as well as the US; international eligibility is bounded by the restricted jurisdictions in Section VI of the Member Agreement, and Kalshi puts the legality question on the member, saying it gives no individual legal or eligibility advice. Federal DCM status does not settle the state question: sports, election and entertainment contracts are geofenced for customers in Nevada (Nevada Gaming Control Board agreement, geofencing due 12 August 2026), Washington (state court order, August 2026) and Michigan, with litigation live in several other states. Sources: Kalshi Help Center, 'Signing Up as an Individual' (article dated 10 March 2026) and 'Can I trade on Kalshi from outside the United States?' (20 March 2026); Kalshi Member Agreement, Section VI; CFTC Release 8302-20 designating KalshiEX LLC; Nevada GCB release, 24 July 2026; CoinDesk, 21 August 2026. Checked 2026-10-21.
apiAccess: Documented and public. docs.kalshi.com covers a REST Trade API (external-api.kalshi.com/trade-api/v2) and a WebSocket streaming API (external-api-ws.kalshi.com/trade-api/ws/v2) for event contracts, plus FIX sessions and a separate API for perpetual futures. Requests are signed with an RSA key created in account settings and sent as KALSHI-ACCESS-KEY, KALSHI-ACCESS-TIMESTAMP and KALSHI-ACCESS-SIGNATURE, which covers market data, portfolio, and order placement and cancellation; a demo environment mirrors production for testing. Sources: Kalshi API documentation, 'Introduction', 'API Keys' and 'API Environments and Endpoints', checked 2026-10-21.
goodFor: US-regulated event contracts in USD at a CFTC-designated exchange (KalshiEX)
Automation: documented REST, WebSocket and FIX APIs with a demo environment
Economics, financial data and weather markets alongside sports and elections
International members, where the country is not on the Member Agreement's restricted list
notGoodFor: Sports, election and entertainment contracts in Nevada, Washington and Michigan, which are geofenced
On-chain settlement or self-custody: Kalshi is a custodial, fiat exchange
Traders in a jurisdiction listed as restricted in Section VI of the Member Agreement

name: Robinhood
shortDescription: Regulated US event contracts from Robinhood Derivatives, traded in the mobile app.
description: Robinhood sells binary Yes/No event contracts through Robinhood Derivatives, LLC, a CFTC-registered futures commission merchant that routes orders to CFTC-regulated exchanges: KalshiEX, ForecastEx, Rothera Exchange and Clearing, and the North American Derivatives Exchange, plus a selection of football contracts routed to Crypto.com and OG.com's exchange since 8 September 2026. The prediction markets hub opened on 17 March 2025 with a fed funds contract and the college basketball tournaments; pro and college football arrived on 19 August 2025. Contracts now span sports, politics and elections, economics and financial data, crypto, climate and weather, commodities and entertainment. Trading is mobile-app only and US-only, and needs a separately approved derivatives account.
pricingDetails: Commission has been probability-weighted since 1 June 2026: k x p x (1 - p) x contracts, where k is 10% without Robinhood Gold or 5% with Gold (a $5 monthly subscription). Rounded up to the nearest $0.01 per trade and capped at $0.01 per contract, so the commission peaks near 50c and nearly vanishes at 1c and 99c. Partner exchanges charge their own fee on top, up to about $0.01 per contract, on both opening and closing trades. Source: Robinhood Help Center, 'Event contracts overview', checked 2026-10-21.
eligibility: US residents aged 18 or older, with an individual Robinhood brokerage account and a separately approved Robinhood Derivatives account, applied for inside the app. Event contracts are not available in all states: Maryland and Nevada residents cannot trade sports event contracts, and Michigan residents could not open new sports event contracts as of 9 September 2026. Robinhood says further state restrictions may apply and that the app holds the current list. Source: Robinhood Help Center, 'Event contracts overview', checked 2026-10-21.
apiAccess: None published for event contracts. Robinhood's developer documentation at docs.robinhood.com covers the Robinhood Crypto Trading API only, and prediction markets can be traded in the mobile app only, so there is no documented endpoint for reading or placing event-contract orders. Sources: Robinhood Help Center, 'Trading event contracts'; docs.robinhood.com, checked 2026-10-21.
goodFor: Trading sports, election and economics contracts inside a US brokerage account you already use
Cheap trades at the price extremes: the probability-weighted commission shrinks toward 1c and 99c
Anyone who wants CFTC-regulated event contracts in USD without a crypto wallet or gas fees
notGoodFor: Automation: no event-contract API is published
Desktop trading: the web version is view-only and Robinhood Legend does not carry event contracts
Order-book analysis: the app shows prices and volume, not full market depth

Also offers Trade API and Data API for developers.
pricingDetails: Free to use. API access and advanced features may have tiered pricing.

name: Foresee
shortDescription: Social prediction layer on Solana powered by Jupiter and Polymarket.
description: A prediction market on Solana where users can trade their beliefs on news, crypto, and events. Powered by Jupiter Exchange and Polymarket, Foresee acts as a social prediction layer where every trade is a belief about the future. Features referral volume campaigns with $SKR token rewards. Built during the Solana x Colosseum Cypherpunk Hackathon.
pricingDetails: Free to trade. Solana gas fees apply. $SKR token rewards for referrals.

name: YinYang
shortDescription: Celebrity micro-predictions market on BNB Chain.
description: A celebrity-focused micro-predictions market on BNB Chain where users can bet on celebrity life events. Endorsed by celebrities and run by the community. Features the $YIN token which saw 2000%+ growth. Part of the BNB Chain prediction market ecosystem with planned CEX listings and celebrity reveals.
pricingDetails: Free to use. BNB Chain gas fees apply. $YIN token available.

name: Futarchy
shortDescription: First futarchy governance protocol on Ethereum.
description: The first futarchy implementation on Ethereum, enabling DAOs to govern via prediction markets. Instead of voting on proposals directly, tokenholders bet on outcomes to determine which decisions maximize treasury value. Integrated with Snapshot Labs for advisory futarchy, allowing delegates to see expected market impact before voting. Currently running on GnosisDAO and Kleros proposals.
pricingDetails: Free to participate. Ethereum gas fees apply.

name: PredMart
shortDescription: Margin account for Polymarket: up to 5x leverage, or borrow USDC against shares.
description: PredMart is a non-custodial margin and lending protocol for Polymarket. Traders open leveraged positions with up to 5x in one click, or deposit prediction-market shares as collateral to borrow USDC without closing their trades. Lenders supply USDC to the pool to earn yield. Built on Polygon.
pricingDetails: Free to use; protocol fees on borrowing and leveraged positions.

name: Polywise
shortDescription: Free Duolingo-style learning game for prediction markets.
description: A free, game-like course that teaches beginners how prediction markets work: reading prices as probabilities, judging edge and expected value, understanding fees and resolution criteria — built on case studies from real Polymarket markets. Includes a free payout/edge calculator and a 40-term plain-English glossary. Browser-based, no account or deposit required.
pricingDetails: Completely free. No account, no deposit, no paid tier.

name: PolyMaster
shortDescription: Prediction market intelligence platform with on-chain analytics and copy trading.
description: PolyMaster is a prediction market intelligence platform built for Polymarket. It combines transparent on-chain analytics, trader evaluation, and automated copy execution to help users identify repeatable trading skill, not just historical profitability. By providing deeper context beyond leaderboard rankings, PolyMaster helps traders make more informed decisions and is currently free to use.

name: TraderBear
shortDescription: Paper-first AI trading agent and virtual pet for prediction markets.
description: TraderBear is a paper-first AI trading agent and virtual pet for prediction markets. It turns plain-English research and trading goals into explicit strategies and simulated trades, with risk controls and transparent reasoning. Live execution is unavailable at signup and remains gated behind sustained qualification and user-selected permissions.

name: Alphascope
shortDescription: AI-powered prediction market research workspace for traders and researchers.
description: Alphascope is an AI-powered prediction market research workspace for traders and researchers. It combines live odds, AI forecasts, news-impact analysis, alerts, and cross-platform context across Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold, and Opinion.

name: Polymarket Pulse
shortDescription: Observe-only intelligence layer for Polymarket with Telegram alerts.
description: Polymarket Pulse is an observe-only intelligence layer for Polymarket. It surfaces live market movers, personal watchlists, quality-gated threshold alerts, and Trader Follow notifications in Telegram without wallet connection, custody, or trade execution.

name: PolyTrace
shortDescription: Research tracked $1K+ Polymarket fills with market context, wallet evidence, and explicit coverage.
description: PolyTrace organizes a tracked subset of public Polymarket fills worth $1K+ and links them to market and proxy-wallet evidence. It publishes live activity, Outcome-level signals, wallet performance context, weekly reports, and an optional Chrome extension while stating coverage and freshness limits explicitly.
pricingDetails: Free public research site and Chrome extension.

name: Predictions.io
shortDescription: Cross-venue analytics comparing Kalshi and Polymarket odds in topic-based lobbies.
description: Predictions.io is a cross-venue prediction-market analytics platform that groups markets from Kalshi and Polymarket into topic-based lobbies so the same question can be compared side by side. It adds whale-trade tracking, an odds converter, and a fee calculator, plus a public API for developers. Predictions.io does not hold funds or execute trades.

name: OVERROUND
shortDescription: Ranks Polymarket wallets by skill-adjusted accuracy instead of profit.
description: Grades any public Polymarket wallet on the prices it actually paid, collapsing correlated markets into independent events and shrinking small samples toward category baselines. A free checker returns one of three verdicts on whether a record is distinguishable from luck, and every alert the service has sent is graded in public afterwards, losses included.
pricingDetails: Free leaderboard preview and wallet checker; alert subscription from $19/mo.

name: CLSTR news
shortDescription: News, not noise: 100k+ articles/day deduplicated into situations with timelines. Free, no key.
description: CLSTR reads 100,000+ articles a day from 40,000+ sources in 170+ countries and deduplicates them into single events, then links related events into ongoing situations with a maintained summary and a full timeline. An agent can answer what has happened over the last six weeks, not just what a single headline says right now.
pricingDetails: Free for basic usage, paid tiers for advanced features

name: Conviction Lens
shortDescription: Reconstructs public Polymarket wallet histories with verified PnL, win rate, drawdown and position detail.
description: Conviction Lens reconstructs complete public Polymarket wallet histories so traders can compare verified PnL, profit factor, win rate, drawdown, open positions and return concentration. Every published profile passes completeness and reconciliation checks. It does not connect to wallets, execute trades or recommend positions.

name: Prediction Bubbles
shortDescription: Live Polymarket and Kalshi odds on one board, sized by volume - see where the venues disagree.
description: Live odds from Polymarket and Kalshi on one board, sized by volume and colored by probability. The one place you can see where the two venues disagree. Free, no signup, with an embeddable widget and a public JSON feed.

name: Polyrama
shortDescription: Real-time Polymarket and Kalshi terminal: live odds, wallet analytics, signals, backtests and an MCP server.
description: Polyrama is a real-time prediction-market terminal for Polymarket and Kalshi. It combines live odds, cross-venue market search, public-wallet analytics, trader leaderboards, whale and mispricing signals, historical backtests, REST API access, and an open-source MCP server for AI agents.

name: Sonist
shortDescription: Automates live mention-market trades on Kalshi and Polymarket from real-time audio and caption feeds.
description: Sonist automates live mention-market trading on Kalshi and Polymarket. It brings markets from both exchanges into one interface and monitors live audio, subtitle feeds, or accessibility captions for configured words, letting users choose the lowest-latency source available for each event. When Sonist finds a match, it applies the user's risk limits and sends the trade through their exchange account within a price ceiling that guarantees a profit.

name: Polyscope
shortDescription: Polymarket analytics: find profitable wallets, track smart money and compare trader performance.
description: PolyScope is an analytics and research platform for Polymarket traders. It helps users discover profitable wallets, track smart money activity, compare trader performance across categories such as politics, sports, and crypto, and study market behavior using on-chain data. PolyScope also publishes research, guides, and data-driven insights designed to make prediction markets easier to analyze and understand.

name: Vultax
shortDescription: Compares public Polymarket wallets across dated position snapshots on up to eight measured axes.
description: Vultax Trader Radar compares public Polymarket wallets within dated position snapshots on up to eight measured axes. Each card shows its underlying figures, and unavailable measurements are omitted rather than scored as zero. The board is free to browse, while deeper trader positions and trades require a paid plan.

name: Outcome
shortDescription: Native Hyperliquid prediction markets: leveraged outcomes with deep liquidity on HyperCore.
description: Outcome builds prediction markets natively on Hyperliquid's HIP-4 outcome primitive — leveraged, deeply liquid event markets (crypto, indices, commodities, macro) sharing margin with the rest of HyperCore's perpetuals and spot, with a fraction of the fees of standalone venues. First and largest HIP-4 deployer.

name: Bot for Kalshi
shortDescription: Turns plain-English Kalshi trading rules into inspectable, review-first workflows.
description: Bot for Kalshi turns plain-English Kalshi trading rules into inspectable workflows. Users review Paper activity before choosing live execution through their own Kalshi account. Paper trading runs on public market data and needs no Kalshi API key; a verified Kalshi account and API key are required only for live trading. The hosted product is independent of Kalshi.
pricingDetails: Complete plan $99/month. No free trial.

name: Polkamarkt
shortDescription: SORA-based binary prediction markets with KUSD collateral and pari-mutuel settlement.
description: Polkamarkt is a SORA-based binary prediction-market platform using KUSD collateral and XOR network fees, with dynamic pari-mutuel settlement. Available at polkamarkt.com and integrated into Polkaswap. Trading fees apply.
pricingDetails: Free to use. Trading fees apply; XOR network fees on SORA.

name: Glypse
shortDescription: AI analytics for prediction markets: the story behind the odds before you pick a side.
description: Glypse is an AI-powered prediction market analytics and research platform. It gives you the story behind the odds before you pick a side, helping you find an angle on a market and follow it as the story develops.
pricingDetails: Freemium: free analytics and research, with paid tiers.

name: Oracle Markets
shortDescription: Daily AI forecasts on politics, finance and geopolitics, benchmarked against Polymarket and Kalshi.
description: Oracle Markets publishes daily AI-generated forecasts on politics, finance and geopolitics, produced by a set of AI agents and tracked against Polymarket and Kalshi. The site advertises 80% accuracy across 10 agents and 500,000+ predictions. Free to use.
pricingDetails: Free to use.

name: Predxy
shortDescription: Combines the same question across 15 prediction venues into one volume-weighted probability.
description: Predxy is a prediction market aggregator: it matches the same question across 15 venues, including Polymarket, Kalshi, Limitless, Hyperliquid, Outcome, Novig, Myriad and Gemini, and combines their prices into a single volume-weighted probability per question. The site ranks questions by 24-hour volume, compares venues side by side, keeps a watchlist and a market calendar, and publishes an experimental 'Fear & Greed' proxy derived from market activity rather than sentiment. The operator describes the goal as a consumer interface for probabilities, with prediction markets as the underlying data source. Publicly browsable; commercial and data terms are arranged directly with the operator.
pricingDetails: Custom: the site publishes no price list; commercial and data licences are arranged directly with the operator. Browsing the aggregator is public.

name: Macro Markets
shortDescription: Prediction market platform covering politics, elections, economics, sports and global events.
description: Macro Markets is a web-based prediction market platform covering politics, elections, economics, sports and global events, with live probabilities per outcome, search and category filters, and position tracking. The site also publishes educational material on pricing, liquidity and market resolution. Browsing needs no account; participation is subject to the platform's terms and eligibility checks. Trading fees are not published on the site, and the submitter explicitly did not assert that browsing implies fee-free trading.
pricingDetails: Free to browse without an account. Trading fees are not published on the site and no fee-free claim is made for trading — confirm the current schedule with the platform. Account opening may require identity and eligibility checks.
features: Educational Articles on Pricing and Resolution

name: MKTGAP
shortDescription: Measures price gaps across Polymarket, Kalshi, PredictIt, Limitless and Gemini after trading fees.
description: MKTGAP compares the price of the same event on Polymarket, Kalshi, PredictIt, Limitless and Gemini Predictions, then measures how much of the difference survives each platform's trading fees using the official fee formulas (Kalshi fee schedule dated 7 July 2026, Polymarket fee documentation verified 23 September 2026). Free tools include a cross-platform fee calculator, platform guides on fees and eligibility by country, a Kalshi vs Polymarket comparison, a glossary and a published methodology. Public pages show prices with a five-minute delay. MKTGAP does not execute trades.
pricingDetails: Freemium: the fee calculator, platform guides and comparison pages are free; paid tiers are not detailed on the site.

name: StrikePing
shortDescription: Public BTC 15-minute shadow record on Kalshi contracts, plus a separate BTC/ETH/SOL spot-alert membership.
description: StrikePing publishes a public shadow record for Kalshi's 15-minute BTC contracts: prospective estimates, abstentions and skipped decisions are mapped to real KXBTC15M contracts and graded against official outcomes, with early calls and later updates recorded separately. Estimates use an independent Coinbase spot proxy rather than Kalshi's settlement benchmark, and the operator states the collection is still undergoing reliability validation, with historical gaps and rate-limit interruptions visible; the record does not establish profitable trading. A separate $29/month membership delivers BTC, ETH and SOL spot alerts via private Telegram, the web and optional email — it does not include contract alerts or trade execution. Operated by CurrentIQ LLC.
pricingDetails: Paid: $29/month plus applicable tax for the BTC/ETH/SOL spot-alert membership (Telegram, web, optional email). The BTC contract shadow record is free to inspect. No trade execution.

name: PolyEdge
shortDescription: Streams pending Polymarket trades from the Polygon mempool, with an on-chain analytics API.
description: PolyEdge streams pending Polymarket trades from the Polygon mempool before they are included in a block, and provides an on-chain analytics API for trade-by-trade attribution, smart-money tracking and realised P&L. Delivery is server-sent events rather than polling. Aimed at copy-trading bots, traders and prediction market builders; a free tier sits alongside Starter, Individual and Builder plans.
pricingDetails: Freemium: free tier available; Starter, Individual and Builder plans for production workloads.

name: PolyOrderbooks
shortDescription: 250ms historical Polymarket L2 order books, prices and liquidity via REST API and Python SDK.
description: PolyOrderbooks serves historical Polymarket L2 order book snapshots at 250ms resolution, with price history and liquidity metrics, through a REST API and an official Python SDK. The operator reports coverage of 1.16 million crypto and sports markets and 2.5 billion L2 snapshots. A free Starter tier sits alongside Pro and Scale subscriptions, with enterprise S3 bulk exports for larger pulls.
pricingDetails: Freemium: free Starter tier; Pro and Scale subscriptions, plus Enterprise S3 bulk exports for custom limits.

name: ThinBlimp
shortDescription: Puts Kalshi and Polymarket prices in cents beside de-vigged sportsbook odds, with the cross-venue gap.
description: ThinBlimp normalises prices across prediction markets and sportsbooks onto one 0-100 scale in cents, with the American odds alongside: Kalshi and Polymarket beside DraftKings, FanDuel and Pinnacle, the books de-vigged to a no-vig line, and the cross-venue gap shown per game. In-play markets stream off the exchange sockets - the operator cites roughly a second of latency and no polling - while long-dated politics runs from tonight's slate out to multi-year horizons (the site shows the 2028 presidential field). Connecting an account marks your own positions on the rows you hold and consolidates P&L and exposure across venues. Read-only by construction: it places no trades and holds no funds. The terminal is free; Pro covers history, watchlists and alerts.
pricingDetails: Freemium: the terminal is free. Pro is $39/month at the founding price (locked for members) for cross-venue history, watchlists and price alerts. Odds converter, no-vig fair value and fee calculator are free without an account.
features: Odds Converter, No-Vig and Fee Calculator

name: PredictionMarket.tools
shortDescription: Free Polymarket and Kalshi tool directory, comparisons, calculators, and guides.
description: Find Polymarket and Kalshi tools by category and compare platforms. Includes payout and odds calculators, API guides, and a runnable paper trading bot tutorial. The site does not place trades.
pricingDetails: Directory, guides, comparisons and calculators are free to use.
goodFor: Learning to build a paper trading bot

name: Lucyd
shortDescription: Bitcoin up/down rounds from 5 minutes to daily, settled onchain with zero fees - live on Sepolia testnet.
description: Lucyd runs Bitcoin up-or-down prediction rounds with lengths from five minutes to a full day. Each round settles through a smart contract that reads the Pyth BTC/USD price: above the strike, Up wins, and each winning token pays 1 USDC to the wallet. Trading carries no fees, and a position can be sold back to the order book before settlement. A public API and an MCP server let AI agents read markets and trade directly. The product is live on the Sepolia testnet, so rounds carry no real value yet.
pricingDetails: Free: zero trading fees and no paid tier listed. Live on the Sepolia testnet, so no real funds are at stake.
